iterations.strategy: Category B+C: Root cause is 64 thread-local revenue arrays (64 × 800KB = 50MB) exceeding L3 cache (44MB), all zero-initialized sequentially in the main thread via std::vector before the parallel region — causing 50MB of serial page faults and cache thrashing. Fix: (1) Cap threads to min(nproc, qualifying_blocks, 16) — with ~34 qualifying blocks, 16 threads × 800KB = 12.8MB fits comfortably in L3. (2) Allocate thread-local arrays via calloc INSIDE the parallel region for NUMA first-touch locality, eliminating serial initialization bottleneck. (3) Use calloc instead of std::vector to avoid zero-init constructor overhead (OS provides zero pages via copy-on-write). These changes reduce memory pressure by 4× and parallelize initialization cost across threads.
